attributes.name: Master-at-Arms
attributes.powers:
Recharge this card to add 1d4 to your Melee combat check, or 1d6 if you are on a ship. You may play this card when you play a weapon that has the Melee trait; if you do, the check also gains the Finesse trait

Discard this card to explore your location. Add the Swashbuckling trait to your combat checks during this exploration.

corrections.corrected_text: On the ally Master-at-Arms, change the power "When you play a weapon that has the Melee trait on this check, the check gains the Finesse trait" to "You may play this card when you play a weapon that has the Melee trait; if you do, the check also gains the Finesse trait". (This card also appears in the Character Add-On Deck.)
corrections.issue: If I play a weapon that has the Melee trait and then play Master-at-Arms to give the check the Finesse trait, can I still use a power to change the check's skill to Dexterity?
